x: More by luck that judgment I was well placed in the seventh position, at the end of the first mile, with Bailey (Salford), Holden (Tipton), Evenson (Salford), Webster (Birchfield), Dodd (Wirral A.C.) and Sutherland (Birchfield) in front of me.
Meanwhile, heartiest congratulations to Birchfield on their win and wonderful run of success. Also to Salford upon their fine running, which compensated for the loss of Evenson from their team.
Of ours, Arthur Penny came next, with Tom Evenson and Bert Footer all together at the head of the main bunch, and ours close enough to be "alright."
